slides.title: Function Template Basics
slides.prompt: Function templates allow creating functions that operate with generic types. The compiler generates specific function overloads at compile time via type deduction.

slides.title: Template Parameter Syntax
slides.prompt: Fill in the keyword used to introduce a template parameter list.

slides.title: typename vs class Keyword
slides.prompt: What is the difference between 'typename T' and 'class T' in template parameter declarations?
options: There is no functional difference; both are completely interchangeable in type parameters
'typename' works only for primitive types, 'class' works only for user classes
'class' forces T to inherit from a base class
'typename' allocates heap memory for template instances
slides.correctAnswer: There is no functional difference; both are completely interchangeable in type parameters

slides.title: Explicit Template Arguments
slides.prompt: Fill in the syntax to explicitly pass type arguments when calling a function template.

slides.title: Automatic Type Deduction Failure
slides.prompt: When does automatic template argument deduction fail for 'template <typename T> void add(T a, T b)'?
options: When arguments passed have different types (e.g., add(5, 3.14)) without explicit casting
When T is a pointer type
slides.correctAnswer: When arguments passed have different types (e.g., add(5, 3.14)) without explicit casting

slides.title: Multiple Template Parameters
slides.prompt: Fill in the separator between multiple template parameters.
slides.codeSnippet:
template <typename T___ typename U>
auto add(T a, U b) { return a + b; }

slides.title: Template Function Overloading Priority
slides.prompt: How does the compiler resolve calls when both a non-template function and a matching template function exist?
options: Prefers the non-template function if it is an exact match
Throws a compile-time ambiguous call error
slides.correctAnswer: Prefers the non-template function if it is an exact match

slides.title: Trailing Return Type with decltype
slides.prompt: Fill in the syntax for auto return type deduction using trailing return specifier.
slides.codeSnippet:
template <typename T, typename U>
auto multiply(T a, U b) ___ decltype(a * b) { return a * b; }

slides.title: Template Instantiation Timing
slides.prompt: When is code for a specific function template instantiation generated by the compiler?
options: Compile time (when the function template is invoked with specific types)
slides.correctAnswer: Compile time (when the function template is invoked with specific types)

slides.title: Default Template Arguments
slides.prompt: Fill in the operator to assign a default type to a template parameter.
slides.codeSnippet:
template <typename T ___ int>
void process(T val) {}
